# Social options

13 options. Set them in the daemon's `.conf` file or `appsettings.json`. Full reference: [configuration.md](../configuration.md). All areas: [index](README.md).

Daemon says which server reads it. Reload says whether `.reload config` applies it: `live` is applied to the running server, `restart` keeps its value until the next start, `start` is read once when the daemon starts.

## `World:Social`

| Option | Type | Default | Allowed | Daemon | Reload | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AllowTwoSideAddFriend` | `bool` | `false` | true \| false | World | live | AllowTwoSide.AddFriend. |
| `AllowTwoSideChannel` | `bool` | `false` | true \| false | World | live | AllowTwoSide.Interaction.Channel. |
| `AllowTwoSideGroup` | `bool` | `false` | true \| false | World | live | AllowTwoSide.Interaction.Group. |
| `AllowTwoSideGuild` | `bool` | `false` | true \| false | World | live | AllowTwoSide.Interaction.Guild. |
| `MaxChannelNameLength` | `int` | `128` | a whole number, -2147483648 to 2147483647 | World | live | ArcaneCore hardening: the longest channel name (characters) a join accepts; a longer one gets INVALID_NAME and no channel is created. vmangos has no cap and the stock client's limit is UNVERIFIED (not captured from a real client). A custom name is normalized to at most 128 characters (vmangos normalizePlayerName(m_name, 128)), so a longer one is always refused: the default is 128, and a larger value or 0 (no configured cap) is still held to 128. |
| `MaxChannelPassphraseLength` | `int` | `255` | a whole number, -2147483648 to 2147483647 | World | live | ArcaneCore hardening: the longest channel password (characters) accepted on join or when set; over it a join gets WRONG_PASSWORD and a set is ignored. 0 = no cap. Default 255 (unrelated to the 128-character name limit). |
| `MaxJoinedChannels` | `int` | `0` | a whole number, -2147483648 to 2147483647 | World | live | Most channels one player may be in; 0 = unlimited. vmangos has no cap (ChannelMgr.cpp:52-69), so the retail default is 0; a positive value is opt-in hardening (World:Social:MaxJoinedChannels). |
| `OfflineLeaderDelaySeconds` | `int` | `300` | a whole number, -2147483648 to 2147483647 | World | live | Seconds before an offline group leader yields to an online member. Zero disables the handoff. vmangos@0e3ff01 src/game/World.cpp:811,2063-2072 defaults to 300 seconds. |
| `ReadyCheckAnswerIntervalMs` | `int` | `0` | a whole number, -2147483648 to 2147483647 | World | live | ArcaneCore hardening: the shortest time (milliseconds) between two ready-check answers of one member that are forwarded to the leader; answers inside it are dropped (a dropped answer is not replayed, so the leader can keep a stale one), and a new ready check resets it. Off (0) by default, as in vmangos, which forwards every answer, pending check or not (GroupHandler.cpp HandleRaidReadyCheckOpcode): set it only to defend against a member spamming the leader. |
| `VmangosChannelExtensions` | `bool` | `false` | true \| false | World | live | The vmangos-only custom channel names: "World" becomes a General-flagged channel without join/leave announcements and "China" (or its Mandarin name) a Custom one without announcements (vmangos Channel.cpp:63-71). Retail 1.12 has neither, so they are ordinary custom channels unless this is on; it applies to channels created after the change. |

## `World:Social:WriteQueue`

| Option | Type | Default | Allowed | Daemon | Reload | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `MaxPendingPerCharacter` | `int` | `256` | a whole number, -2147483648 to 2147483647 | World | start | Most friend/ignore rows of one character that may be waiting for storage (queued or retained). 0 or less: unlimited. |
| `MaxPendingTotal` | `int` | `25000` | a whole number, -2147483648 to 2147483647 | World | start | Most friend/ignore rows of all characters waiting for storage. 0 or less: unlimited. |
| `RetryDelayMs` | `int` | `200` | a whole number, -2147483648 to 2147483647 | World | start | Backoff unit between the three attempts of one write, in milliseconds (attempt n waits n times this). |
